name: gyd-wallet
description: Phase 1 prototype: a GYD wallet, free-to-play games (coin flip, slots, and a 2/4-player Ludo board game), Cash App-style $cashtag payments and money requests, GYD Direct (our own send-to-anyone transfer feature), a searchable business directory with customizable pages, photo product/price listings, pickup-or-delivery checkout, business-posted events with in-app ticket sales (QR ticket codes, door check-in, a 3.5% platform fee), a separate business wallet, a business payment portal, and messaging. Zero external dependencies — runs on Node.js 22+ using node:sqlite.
